snippet.title: Movidle — Daily Movie Wordle Gameplay
snippet.description:
Movidle (movidle.fun) is the daily movie wordle for film fans. Five poster pieces, one trivia clue and one synopsis reveal a different film every day. Guess in three tries — fewer clues used, higher score.

Play free at https://movidle.fun
